items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: I played at the Green Mill in Chicago for Tom Chimali.

ctx.x: Well we have books that tell all about your records.

You see if I had been like, I was doing so well and I was so busy that I didn't have time to put dates on anything or who the person was. I played in the All-Star Orchestra in Chicago when I was at the Green Mill. I played at the Green Mill in Chicago for Tom Chimali. And I was this trumpet player selected to play with all the stars and I can't tell you who they were and I know they must be all famous musicians. I went there to some big ballroom, we sat down, they handed out the music, we played it. The piano…

Okay. How would you contrast the public taste in music, especially in New Orleans, as it changed during the years from the first that you remember to about 1930? What kind of music did people seem to want in those years, at various times?
